m: 1. उपे (उप-√ इ) P. -ऐति, to go or come or step near, approach, betake one's self to, arrive at, meet with, turn towards, RV.; AV.; TS.; ŚBr.; MBh.; Śak. &c.; to approach (any work), undergo, set about, undertake, perform (a sacrifice), devote one's self to, RV. ii, 2, 11; AV. ix, 6, 4; VS.; AitBr.; ŚBr.; to come near to, reach, obtain, enter into any state, fall into; undergo, suffer, RV. iv, 33, 2; ŚBr.; AitBr.; Ragh.; Pañcat. &c.; to approach sexually, TS. ii, v; Mn. ix, 4; xi, 172; MBh.; Suśr.; Kathās.; to approach a teacher, become a pupil, ŚBr. x, xi; BṛĀrUp.; ChUp.; to occur, be present, make one's appearance, RPrāt.; R.; to happen, fall to one's share, befall, incur, RV. i, 167, 1; vii, 84, 3; Hit.; Bhag. &c.; to join (in singing), ŚāṅkhŚr.; to regard as, admit, acknowledge, Sāh. Comm. on Nyāyam.; to comprehend, understand, Sarvad. : Intens. Ā. (1. pl. -ईमहे) to implore (a god), RV. x, 24, 2.

2. उपे (उप-आ-√ इ) P. -एति, to approach, come near or towards, RV.; AV.; ŚBr.; to apply to, implore, RV. viii, 20, 22; (with शरणम्) to approach for protection; to approach sexually, MBh.; to reach, obtain, strive to obtain, Bhartṛ.
a: उपे — {c2c} P. [उप-इ] 1 To approach, come near, arrive at, reach (a place, person &c.); लतामुपेत्य Ś. 1; so राजानं, दुर्गं &c. योगी परं स्थानमुपैति चाद्यं Bg. 8. 28, 10, 15, 9. 28. --2 To go to (a master), become a pupil. --3 To have intercourse with (a woman), cohabit; Ms. 9. 4. --4 To undergo, perform, undertake, practise; तपः, सत्रं &c. --5 To go to or pass into any state; योगं R. 16. 84; भेदं Ku. 2. 4; to fall into (misfortune &c.); क्षयं, मृत्युं, सुखं, दुःखं, निद्रां &c. --6 To obtain, attain to; उपैति शस्यं परिणामरम्यतां Ki. 4. 22. --7 To incur, be present at. --8 To fall to one's lot or share, befall; उद्योगिनं पुरुषसिंहमुपैति लक्ष्मीः Pt. 1. 361; Bg. 6. 27. --9 To consider as, admit, acknowledge.

उपेंद्रः — [उपगत इंद्रं अनुज-वात्] N. of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa as the younger brother of Indra in his 5th or dwarf incarnation; see इंद्र; उपेंद्रवज्रादपि दारुणोऽसि Gīt. 5; यदुपेंद्रस्त्वमतींद्र एव सः Śi. 16. 70. --Comp. --वज्रा f. N. of a metre; see App.

m: उपेक्ष् (उप-√ ईक्ष्) Ā. -ईक्षते (rarely P.) to look at or on ŚBr.; MBh.; to perceive, notice, R.; to wait on patiently, expect, Suśr.; to overlook, disregard, neglect, abandon, MBh.; R.; Śak.; Pañcat. &c.; to connive at, grant a respite to, allow, MBh. v; to regard, Pañcat.
a: उपेक्ष् — {c1c} A. 1 To neglect, overlook, disregard, connive at; किमात्मनिर्वादकथामुपेक्षे R. 14. 34; उपेक्षते यः श्लथलंबिनीर्जटाः Ku. 5. 47. --2 To let escape or let go; नोपेक्षेत क्षणमपि राजा साहसिकं नरं Ms. 8. 344. --3 To quit, abandon. --4 To despise, slight. --5 To notice, consider, have regard to; एवमुच्चावच नर्थान् प्राहुः ते उपेक्षितव्याः Nir. --6 To look at, regard, perceive; प्रासादरथा ह्युपैक्षत Nala. 22. 5.

endurance, patience
dissent

a: उपेक्षा — 1 Overlooking, disregard, neglect. --2 Indifference, contempt, disdain; कुर्यामुपेक्षां हतजीवितेऽस्मिन् R. 14. 65. --3 Leaving, quitting. --4 Endurance, patience. --5 Dissent. --6 Neglect, trick or deceit (one of the 7 expedients in war). --7 A sort of भावना in Yoga, q. v. --8 Regard, consideration.

v: upendra

pu॰ upagata indram anujatvAt atyA॰ sa॰ । 1 vizRO । sa hi kaSyapAt aditO indrAdanantaraM vAmanarUpatayA saMjAtaH iti tasya taTAtvam । “upendro vAmanaH prAMSuH” vizRusa॰ । atra BAzye anyApi niruktirdarSitA yaTA । “mamopari yaTendrastvaM sTApitogoBirISvaraH । upendra iti kfzRa! tvAM gAsyanti divi devatAH” iti harivaMSavacanAt upari indraH upendraH” iti । atra vAsudevasyEva yaTopendranAmatA, taTA govardDanodDAraRena gozu rakzitAsu tatprItaye goBistasya sarvoparilIkasTitatvena upendranAmatayA'BizekaH kfta iti varRRitaM harivaM॰ 76 a॰ yaTA । “apAmaDastAlloko'yaM tasyopari mahIDarAH । nAgAnAmuparizwAdBUH pfTivyupari mAnuzAH । manuzyalokAdUrdDvaM tu KagAnAM gatirucyate । AkASasyopari ravirdvAraM svargasya BAnumAn । devalokaH parastasmAdvimAnagamano mahAn । yatrAhaM kfzRa! devAnAmEndre vinihitaH pade । svargAdUrdDvaM brahmaloko maharzigaRapUjitaH । tatra somagatiScEva jyotizAYca mahAtmanAm । tasyopari gavAM lokaH sidDAstaM pAlayanti hi । sa hi sarvagataH kfzRa! mahAkASagato mahAn । uparyupari tatrApi gatistava tapomayI । yAM na vidma vayaM sarve pfcCanto'pi pitAmaham । lokAstvaDo duzkftinAM nAgalokastu dAruRaH । pfTivI karmaSIlAnAM kzetraM sarvasya karmaRaH । KamasTirARAM vizayo vAyunA tulyavarttinAm । gatiH SamadamAQyAnAM svargaH sukftakarmaRAm । brAhme tapasi yuktAnAM brahmalokaH parA gatiH । gavAmeva tu goloko durArohA hi sA gatiH । sa tu lokastvayA kfzRa! sIdamAnaH kfpAtmanA । Dfto DftimatA vIra! niGnatopadravaM gavAm । tadahaM samanuprApto gavAM vAkyena noditaH । brahmaRaSca mahABAga । gOravAttava cAnaGa! । ahaM BUtapatiH kfzRa! devarAjaH purandaraH । aditergarBaparyAye pUrvvajaste purAtanaH । tejastejasvinaScEva yatte darSitavAnaham । meGarUpeRa tatsarvaM kzantumarhasi me viBo! । evaM kzAntamanAH kfzRa! syena sOmyena tejasA । brahmaRaH SfRu me vAkyaM gavAYca gajavikrama! । Aha tvAM BagavAn brahmA gAvaScAkASagA divi । karmaBistozitA divyEstava saMrakzaRAdiBiH । BavatA rakzitA lokA golokaSca mahAnayam । tadvayaM puNgavEH sArdDaM vardDvAmaH prasavEstaTA । karzakAn puNgavErvAhyErmmeDyena havizA surAn । SriyaM Sakftpravfttena tarpayizyAmaH kAmadAH । tadasmAkaM gurustvaM hi prARadaSca mahAbala! । adyapraBfti no rAjA tvamindro vE Bava praBo! । tasmAttvaM kAYcamEH pUrRErddivyasya payaso GawEH । eBiradyABizicyasva mayA hastAvanAmitEH । ahaM kilendro devAnAM tvaNgavAmindratANgataH । govinda iti lokAstvAM stAzyanti Buvi SASvatam । mamopari yaTendrastvaM sTApito gomiroSvaraH । upendra iti kfzRa! tvAM gAsyanti divi devatAH” । “tataH Sakrastu tAn gfhya GawAn divyapayoDarAn । aBizekena govindaM yojayAmAsa yogavit । dfzwvA'BiBicyamAnaM taM gAvastAH saha yUTapEH । stanEH prasravasaMyuktEH sizicuH kfzRamavyayam । meGASca divi muktABiH sAmftABiH samantataH । sizicustoyaDArABiH sicyamAnaM tamavyayam । vanaspatInAM sarvezAM susrAvendanimaM payaH । vavarza puzpavarzaYca nedustUrTARi cAmbare । stuvanti munayaH sarvebAgBirmantraparAyaRAH । ekArRavaviviktaYca daDAra vasuDA vapuH । prasAdaM sAgarA jagmurtavurvAtA jagadDitAH । mArgasTo vibaBO BAnuH somo nakzatrasaMyutaH । ItayaH praSamaM jagmurjagmurnivErratAM nfpAH । pravAlapatraSavalAH puzpavantaSca pAdapAH । madaM prasusnuvurnAgA yAtAstozaM vane mfgAH । alaNkftA nAtraruhErDAtuBirBAnti parvatAH । devalokopamo lokastfpto'mftarasEriva । AsIt kfzRABizeke hi divyaH svargarasokzitaH । aBiziktantu taM goBiH Sakro govindamavyayam । divyamAlyAmbaraDaraM devadevo'bravIdidam । eza te praTamaH kfzRa! niyogo gozu yaH kftaH” । tatrEva 17 a॰ । “Sakrastu svayamAgatya dEvatEH saha vftrahA । aBizicyAbravIt kfzRamupendreti SacIpatiH” । vAsudevasyEvendreRa upendranAntrA'BizekaH kftaH ityuktam । BA॰ 8 ska॰ 33 a॰ tu vAmanasyEva tannAmatoktA yaTA vAmanena balerdamanAnantaram । “kaSyapasyAditeH prItyE sarvvaBUtaBavAya ca । lokAnAM lokapAlAnAmakarot vAmanaM patim । vedAnAM sarvadevAnAM Darmasya yaSasAM SriyaH । maNgalAnAM vratAnAYca kalpaM svargApavargayoH । upendraM kalpayAYcakre iti sarvaviBUtaye iti” “prApya triBuvanaYcendra upendraBujapAlitaH” iti tatrEva । vAmanasya upendratvamindrAnujAtatvAt vAsudevasya tu pUrdoktaprakAreRa tannAmatA uBayoreva eka parameSvarAMSatvAnna viroDaH । “tadindrasandikfzwasupendra! yadvacaH” mAGe nAradasya vAsudevasamboDanatayA prayogaH ।
m: उपेन्द्र m. ‘younger brother of Indra’, N. of Viṣṇu or Kṛṣṇa (born subsequently to Indra, especially as son of Aditi, either as Āditya or in the dwarf Avatāra), MBh.; Hariv.; R.; VP. &c.
N. of a Nāga, L.

उपेन्द्र—बल m. N. of various men.
उपेन्द्र—दत्त m. N. of various men.
